name: F3 Mobile Screen Magnifier | Enlarged Mobile Screen Amplifier & Eye Protection (Random Color)
description:
The F3 Mobile Screen Magnifier is designed to enlarge your smartphone display for a more comfortable, cinematic viewing experience. Suitable for phones up to 7 inches, it uses a high-quality Fresnel HD lens to magnify the screen 3–4× while reducing eye strain and radiation exposure. The ergonomic viewing design, adjustable angle, and sliding protective cover make it perfect for watching movies, gaming, reading, or video calls. Lightweight and foldable, it is ideal for travel, home, office, and outdoor use.
Key Features:
Fresnel HD lens magnifies screen 3–4×
Ergonomic adjustable viewing angle
Sliding design protects lens during storage
Anti-slip silicone pad keeps phone stable
Reduces eye strain and mobile radiation
Compatible with all smartphones under 7 inches
How to Use:
1⃣ Slide open the lens panel
2⃣ Pull out the stand and place your phone on the holder
3⃣ Adjust viewing distance and angle
4⃣ Enjoy enlarged display without straining your eyes
5⃣ Fold flat after use for easy storage
Ingredients / Materials:
ABS plastic, Fresnel HD optical lens, silicone pads
Safety Information:
Do not expose lens to direct sunlight
Keep away from sharp or hot objects
Clean lens gently with a soft cloth
Avoid dropping or bending the frame
